steps: Run setup to deterministically (re)create all sample CSVs under demo_data/.
Run help: confirm --window, --logon-types and --output are listed with defaults 10, 2,3,10 and stdout.
Run basic_alert_exit3: one JSON-line alert for alice across HOST-H1/HOST-H2; verify process exit code is 3.
Pipe the alert line through a JSON parser and confirm fields account, hosts, first_time, last_time, event_count are complete and times end with +00:00.

Run bad_rows_isolated: the bad timestamp and the 4-field short row are skipped into error_events.log while processing completes; then run show_error_log to confirm each log line has a UTC timestamp, error type and the original row text.
Run three_hosts_merged: exactly one alert with event_count 3 and three hosts, proving same-window cross-host merging.
Run window_too_small_no_alert_exit0: with --window 4 the 5-minute-spaced events no longer fit, stdout is empty and exit code is 0.
Run window_zero_rejected_exit2 and missing_column_exit2: both print an error to stderr and exit with code 2 (parameter / header errors).
Run logon_type_filter: --logon-types 2 ignores the type-3 event, so no alert is emitted (exit 0).
Run timezone_normalized_to_utc: the 10:00+08:00 event appears in the alert as 02:00:00+00:00 UTC; the Z-suffixed event is also accepted.
Run alert_ordering: alice's alert is printed before bob's, demonstrating first_time ascending ordering.
Run output_to_file: alerts are written to demo_output/alerts.jsonl instead of stdout.
Run unwritable_output_exit1: pointing --output at an existing directory reports an error and exits with code 1.
Run volume_1100_memory_cap: 1100 events stream through the 1000-event cap; the sliding window still emits an alert based on in-window events.
Run acceptance_suite: the full 52-check acceptance suite ends with '52/52 checks passed'.

demo.title: Credential reuse detector - terminal walkthrough
demo.description: Standard-library Python CLI detecting same-account successful logons across multiple hosts within a sliding window. All inputs are deterministic local CSV samples; no network or containers are used.
